profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cynosure, LLC.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer for the CRS2 project (Dream Chaser), an unmanned drone meant to launch on an Atlas V, deliver cargo to the International Space Station, then glide back to Earth.  Working on the design/documentation of the I/O section of code, primarily MIL-STD-1553, along with some discretes and non-1553 data.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer for the Caravan project, a tissue removal system for fibroids and cysts in the uterus.  Consists of a handpiece with a PWM motor controller to drive a sheathed blade, attached to a console with multiple pump controls and a 7 inch color LCD touchscreen.  Both chips used are ARM Cortex M4s.  All code written/documented to satisfy IEC 62304.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer for the Leapfrog project, a tissue removal system for fibroids and cysts in the uterus.  Designed around an ARM-M4 chip (the Wonder Gecko from Silicon Labs), consisted of a handpiece with a PWM motor controller to drive a sheathed blade, attached to a console with multiple pump controls and a 5 digit seven-segment LCD display.  Both chips used are ARM Cortex M4s.  All code written/documented to satisfy IEC 62304.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer for the ADM project, an air data computer for use on export versions of the F-16. Created the Software Requirements Document and the Software Design Document in DOORS, created the design architecture, developed the prototype and lead the development of the final product in C for a Silicon Labs 8051 (C8051F582).  Code developed using Silicon Lab’s Simplicity Studio™ IDE. Problem Reports created and tracked through JIRA. All deliverables/development work stored in Perforce. Also developed updates for the EVS‑II® System (Enhanced Vision System) for FedEx and Gulfstream aircraft.  All code written for the µCOS‑II RTOS using the Metrowerks Code Warrior C compiler.  Some experience coding prototypes for the Silicon Labs 32-bit MCU’s (Leopard and Wonder Gecko lines).

positions.title: Senior Principal Engineer
positions.description: Lead software developer for the UBMF project, an onboard monitor for flight and engine data for a client (Pratt & Whitney ‑ UBMF is a sub‑function of their upcoming EFAST® System). Participated in the development of the Software Requirements Document and the Software Design Document in DOORS, created the design architecture, developed the prototype and lead the development of the final product in C for a DEOS ARINC-653 OS.  Worked closely with the clients integration team to support engineering builds and meet all deadlines. Problem Reports created and tracked through JIRA. All deliverables/development work stored in Subversion.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Senior software developer for embedded systems. Lead developer for the ATHUD® System (a Heads Up Display) currently certified for the Challenger 600 series of aircraft. Lead integrator for the EVS‑II® System, with primary software developer role for the MCDU and Fault Reporting functions on that system. All code written for the µCOS‑II RTOS using the Code Warrior C compiler. The Software Requirements Document and the Software Design Document created in DOORS.  Problem Reports created and tracked through JIRA. All deliverables/development stored in CSRCS (ATHUD) or WinCVS (EVS-II). This development was done on an in-house hardware design, so I worked closely with the Electrical and Firmware teams during extensive labwork to debug hardware/software issues.

positions.title: Senior Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Developed C, C++ and ADA code for various avionics clients, primarily Honeywell (both commercial and business) and Smiths (now GE Aviation). Created Software Requirements Documents, Software Design Documents, Architectural Diagrams as well as developed code for those systems. Worked in I/O (Arinc
429 and Arinc 664), Flight Displays, Fault Management and Flight Maintenance Systems (FMS), MCDU, among others.

positions.title: Contract Engineer
positions.description: Wrote ADA code as part of the software development team for the I/O and Flight displays systems for the MD‑10/MD‑11 and B‑737 aircraft. The operating system was an early, Honeywell designed, ARINC‑653 RTOS.
